notes: {"answer":"This is often a stomach bug, usually viral, and most kids get better at home within a few days. Still drinking and making wet diapers is a good sign. Keep offering small, frequent sips of fluid or oral rehydration solution, and keep breast or formula feeds going.","triage":"Call 811 if vomiting lasts over 48 hours, it is no better in 3-4 days, or there are fewer wet diapers, dry mouth, no tears or sunken eyes. Under 3 months old: call 811 right away. Go to the ER or call 911 now if hard to wake, confused, vomiting blood or green, bloody stool, or severe belly pain.","sources":["KidsHealth","Michigan Medicine","UpToDate patient education","NHS"]}
